title: Investigating Learner-Aware Design of LLM-Generated Educational Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2602.11650v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) show promise for generating educational feedback, it remains unclear how feedback should be designed (e.g., tone and information coverage) to support answer revision and learner acceptance across diverse learner profiles. We define six feedback designs for multiple-choice biology questions, including a baseline design and variants with additional feedback elements, and conduct an empirical study with high school students. We evaluate feedback using immediate revision performance and six subjective evaluation criteria, and analyze how feedback preferences vary across learner profiles based on personality traits. translated_title: 面向学习者感知的LLM生成教育反馈设计研究
translated_abstract: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在生成教育反馈方面展现出潜力，但尚不清楚如何设计反馈（例如语气和信息覆盖范围）以支持不同学习者特征下的答案修正和接受度。我们为多项选择题生物学问题定义了六种反馈设计，包括基线设计及带有额外反馈元素的变体，并针对高中生进行了实证研究。我们使用即时修正表现和六个主观评价标准评估反馈，并分析基于个性特征的反馈偏好如何随学习者特征变化。结果显示，具有清晰全面指导的反馈能改善修正表现，并在各学习者特征中获得良好评价，而信息新颖性和情感框架则因特征而异。这些发现表明，学习者特征应与反馈设计协同考虑。
tldr: 本研究通过实证分析发现，清晰全面的LLM生成反馈能普遍提升学生修正表现，但反馈的信息新颖性和情感框架需根据学习者个性特征进行个性化设计。
en_tdlr: This study empirically shows that clear and comprehensive LLM-generated feedback improves revision performance across learners, while novelty and affective framing require personalization based on learner personality traits.
